answer.reason: The fixed harness calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info initializes row state. Both source versions report that duplicate call through png_app_error. The packet does not establish whether the initial PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN state makes that report a warning or an error, so it cannot establish that row decoding is blocked.

scope_contract.reason: Sequential row reading and this initialization sequence are part of the target's primary operation.

feasible_trigger.reason: For an accepted small PNG whose row setup succeeds, png_read_update_info sets PNG_FLAG_ROW_INIT; the harness then unconditionally calls png_start_read_image, reaching its duplicate-call branch.

observable_consequence.reason: png_app_error warns when PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN is set and calls png_error otherwise. The flag's initial value is missing. If the error reaches the harness's setjmp recovery, it returns before png_read_row; that outcome is not established for this build.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The fixed harness has no alternate call sequence around the duplicate report. png_read_row can initialize row state itself, but the harness calls png_start_read_image first. Whether the existing sequence nevertheless reaches rows depends on the unresolved warning policy.

identity_preserved.reason: The same update → start → row-reading tuple occurs in the unchanged old harness against identical before and after duplicate-call contracts. Timing remains unresolved with the consequence.

harness_evidence.quote:
# Disable logging via library build configuration control.
cat scripts/pnglibconf.dfa | \
  sed -e "s/option STDIO/option STDIO disabled/" \
      -e "s/option WARNING /option WARNING disabled/" \
      -e "s/option WRITE enables WRITE_INT_FUNCTIONS/option WRITE disabled/" \
> scripts/pnglibconf.dfa.temp
mv scripts/pnglibconf.dfa.temp scripts/pnglibconf.dfa

# build the library.
autoreconf -f -i
./configure
make -j$(nproc) clean
make -j$(nproc) libpng16.la

# build libpng_read_fuzzer.
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -I. \
     $SRC/libpng/contrib/oss-fuzz/libpng_read_fuzzer.cc \
     -o $OUT/libpng_read_fuzzer \
     -lFuzzingEngine .libs/libpng16.a -lz
